text:
Helen Park: Heads up — INV-2026-02020 generated with a USD vs EUR mismatch. Customer billed in EUR but ledger recorded USD amounts, and a retry created a duplicate INV-2026-02020-dup. Can someone triage?
Diego Morales: Please paste the invoice ids + generator payloads / ledger entries.
Helen Park: Generator output: `{"id":"INV-2026-02020","customer":"NordicAI","currency":"EUR","lines":[{"desc":"subscription (Jul)","amount_cents":100000},{"desc":"overage","amount_cents":25000}],"total_cents":125000,"status":"issued"}`
Ledger entry snapshot: `invoice_id=INV-2026-02020 currency=USD amount_cents=125000 ledger_id=LED-8092`
Sabrina Cho: That looks like currency normalization got dropped when the ledger write happened. Any idempotency or retry logs?
Billing Bot: billing-generator: WARNING at 2026-07-10T02:05:08Z "idempotency key missing: invoice-2026-02020" -> created duplicate id INV-2026-02020-dup job=bgen-20260710-44
Diego Morales: Did the mailer send both invoices to the customer?
Billing Bot: mailer-service: delivered INV-2026-02020 to billing@nordic.ai at 2026-07-10T02:05:30Z; delivered INV-2026-02020-dup to billing@nordic.ai at 2026-07-10T02:06:01Z
Sabrina Cho: Immediate actions: void the duplicate, reconcile the ledger so currency matches the invoice (EUR), and pause generator retries. Need finance lead approval to mutate ledger.
Helen Park: Approve void + ledger correction. Proceed. :white_check_mark:
Diego Morales: Ran commands: `opsctl worker pause billing-generator-retry` ; `billing-cli invoice void --id INV-2026-02020-dup --reason "duplicate/retry" --force` ; `billing-cli invoice reconcile --id INV-2026-02020 --set-currency EUR --force`
Billing Bot: void result: `{"id":"INV-2026-02020-dup","status":"voided"}` ; reconcile result: `{"id":"INV-2026-02020","currency":"EUR","ledger_amount_cents":125000}`
Sabrina Cho: Filing ENG-5622: "Currency normalization lost on retry -> duplicate invoices + ledger mismatch" with repro steps and recommendation: enforce currency on ledger writes, persist idempotency keys atomically, and add renderer/email-side validation to reject invoice if ledger currency != invoice.currency. Assigned to @eng-billing and @eng-core, severity=P1.
Helen Park: Notifying support to delay customer outreach until confirmed. Closing thread for now — will re-open if any customer dispute surfaces.
